body: Wan: Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video Generative Models
plain_description: **Create videos and images from text or images with Wan2.1.** Generate, edit, and animate visual content, with options for local use through a Gradio demo or integrations such as ComfyUI and Diffusers.
technical_description: Open suite of video foundation models supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, first-and-last-frame-to-video, video generation and editing with VACE, and text-to-image. Includes 1.3B and 14B models, single- and multi-GPU inference, and optional prompt extension using local Qwen models or the Dashscope API. The README gives an 8.19 GB VRAM figure for the T2V-1.3B model.
title: Wan2.1
